focus.title: 美国拟将34家中国实体列入出口管制清单，涉半导体与AI领域
focus.summary: 据外媒报道，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）拟于近期将34家中国实体列入实体清单，涉及半导体设备、人工智能芯片及高性能计算领域。此举将限制相关企业获取美国原产技术及设备，并可能影响其供应链稳定。中国企业需提前评估合规风险，调整采购策略，并考虑申请许可证或转向替代供应商。
focus.title_en: US to Add 34 Chinese Entities to Export Control List, Targeting Semiconductors and AI
focus.summary_en: According to foreign media reports, the US Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) plans to add 34 Chinese entities to the Entity List, covering semiconductor equipment, AI chips, and high-performance computing. This move will restrict these companies' access to US-origin technology and equipment, potentially disrupting supply chains. Chinese companies should assess compliance risks, adjust procurement strategies, and consider applying for licenses or seeking alternative suppliers.

case.title: 最高法发布涉外民商事典型案例：明确跨境担保独立性审查规则
case.summary: 最高人民法院近期发布一批涉外民商事典型案例，其中一起涉及跨境担保纠纷案，明确了独立保函与从属性担保的区分标准，强调在审查独立保函时，应严格依据保函文本及国际惯例（如URDG758），尊重当事人意思自治。该案为跨境交易中的担保安排提供了清晰指引，有助于减少因担保性质不明引发的争议。
case.source: 来源：最高人民法院公报 · 2026年8月
case.title_en: SPC Publishes Typical Cross-Border Cases: Clarifies Independence Test for Cross-Border Guarantees
case.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court recently published a batch of typical foreign-related civil and commercial cases, including a cross-border guarantee dispute, which clarified the distinction between independent guarantees and accessory guarantees. The court emphasized that when examining independent guarantees, strict adherence to the guarantee text and international practices (such as URDG758) is required, respecting party autonomy. This case provides clear guidance for guarantee arrangements in cross-border transactions, helping to reduce disputes arising from ambiguity.
case.source_en: Source: Gazette of the Supreme People's Court · August 2026

policy.title: 广东自贸区发布跨境数据流动负面清单，便利大湾区数据有序流通
policy.summary: 广东省自贸办近日发布《中国（广东）自由贸易试验区跨境数据流动负面清单》，明确了禁止和限制跨境传输的数据类别，同时简化了合规申报流程。该清单覆盖金融、医疗、汽车等行业，旨在平衡数据安全与经济发展，为粤港澳大湾区企业提供更清晰的合规路径，促进数据要素高效流动。
policy.source: 来源：广东省自贸办 · 2026年8月
policy.title_en: Guangdong Free Trade Zone Issues Negative List for Cross-Border Data Flows, Facilitating Data Circulation in GBA
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Free Trade Zone Office recently issued the "Negative List for Cross-Border Data Flows in China (Guangdong) Pilot Free Trade Zone," specifying categories of data prohibited or restricted from cross-border transfer, while simplifying compliance filing procedures. The list covers sectors such as finance, healthcare, and automobiles, aiming to balance data security and economic development, providing clearer compliance paths for enterprises in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and promoting efficient flow of data elements.

analysis.title: 美国出口管制新规下，中国半导体企业如何构建出口合规体系？
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：随着美国出口管制持续加码，中国半导体企业面临严峻合规挑战。建议企业建立全流程出口合规体系：一是识别受管制物项，梳理产品技术参数；二是建立最终用户和最终用途筛查机制，利用BIS官网及第三方数据库；三是完善内部合规制度，开展定期培训；四是与专业律师合作，及时应对突发管制措施。同时，企业应积极利用合规例外和许可证申请机制，降低业务中断风险。
analysis.title_en: How Chinese Semiconductor Companies Can Build Export Compliance Systems Under New US Export Controls?
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: With the intensification of US export controls, Chinese semiconductor companies face severe compliance challenges. It is recommended that companies establish a full-process export compliance system: first, identify controlled items and map product technical parameters; second, establish end-user and end-use screening mechanisms using BIS official website and third-party databases; third, improve internal compliance policies and conduct regular training; fourth, collaborate with professional lawyers to respond promptly to sudden control measures. Additionally, companies should actively utilize compliance exceptions and license application mechanisms to reduce business interruption risks.
